== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The [[Titan]] [[Force]] was a group of galactic protectors known as Knights who defended the galaxy against various monsters and threats, including the [[D’Niss Swarm]]. While officially reported to have retired after successfully repelling the [[D’Niss]], their reputation remains significant. The organization was headquartered on a terraformed moon orbiting the gas [[giant]] [[Delsin]], which is characterized by dense jungles and diamond rings. The group's power was derived from massive, highly advanced machines known as [[Divine Titans]], which possess technology superior to standard [[Aethertech]]. These machines are so powerful that they can be used to shield colonies or destroy massive insectoid threats, though they carry risks; for instance, a [[Titan]] infused with [[solar dragon]] [[blood]] can become uncontrollable and dangerous to its surroundings. The Knights worked as a coordinated team, utilizing different colored units—such as [[Red]], Blue, Green, and Yellow—to combat large-[[scale]] enemies. While the group was once composed of multiple members, recent accounts suggest only one survivor remains from the original force.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The [[Titan]] [[Force]] is a renowned group of comrades that includes Knights and has earned a significant reputation. This organization features the [[Blue Titan]], Red Divine Titan{{!}}Red Titan, and Green [[Titan]] among its members. [[Raion Raithe]] is a part of this group, having fought alongside these individuals in the past. Both Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion and the narrator were previously members of this collective.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The [[Titan]] [[Force]] is an organization that includes both Kyri Prest{{!}}Kyri and the narrator. Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion is also a member of this group, which maintains its headquarters on [[Delsin]]'s second moon. Despite their presence, the Knights seek revenge against the [[Titan]] [[Force]]. In a previous life involving Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion and the organization, the narrator never joined the ranks of the [[Titan Knights]].}}
